lines.1: 「All right, let's go see the fireworks today!」
lines.2: 「You're not thinking of going all the way to the beach, are you?」
lines.3: 「The beach'll be insanely crowded. Let's watch from the station while we raid the food stalls.」
lines.4: 「The station will be crowded too, but the beach is on another level. That sounds better.」
lines.5: Otome could have seen the fireworks too if she didn't have training camp.
lines.7: 「Wait, Nagomi! We were going to watch the fireworks together, weren't we?」
lines.10: 「No matter how many times you ask, I'm against you remarrying.」
lines.11: 「This is the place where Dad, you, and I lived together, isn't it?」
lines.12: 「We don't need anyone else. It's disgusting.」
lines.13: 「You're the type who refuses to accept a transfer student.」
lines.14: 「Being that carefree is how bad men take advantage of you.」
lines.16: 「Do you really want a new man that badly...?」
lines.18: --A firework burst overhead with a booming bang.
lines.19: The fireworks painting the dark sky in brilliant colors were the greatest attraction of the Matsukasa Port Opening Festival.
lines.20: 「Whoa! Look at all the food stalls!」
lines.27: 「What the hell? He gets lost while I'm eating one kebab?」
lines.28: 「Tch. The crowd's jammed the cell network.」
lines.29: 「Look away for one second and he wanders off... I don't know why, but I've got a bad feeling.」
lines.33: 「Weren't you going to watch the fireworks with your family?」
lines.37: 「Please don't stick your nose where it isn't wanted.」
lines.39: 「I'm going to watch from here too. That okay?」
lines.42: ...I didn't know what had happened, but she was clearly down.
lines.43: Then again, saying so would only make her angry.
lines.44: For now, I decided to stay silently by her side.
lines.45: Why couldn't I leave someone this foul-mouthed alone?
lines.46: Magnificent fireworks kept blooming across the night sky.
lines.47: 「Oh, that's one of those star mines, right?」
lines.49: Yashi said nothing, but since she didn't leave, my presence couldn't be too unpleasant.
lines.53: Yashi murmured during a gap between the fireworks.
lines.54: 「The day after tomorrow... Would you like to go to the beach?」
lines.56: 「I want to blow off some steam.」
lines.58: 「You have been shut in a kitchen making curry nonstop. No wonder you want a break.」
lines.59: 「If you don't want to, forget it.」
lines.61: Another firework launched into the sky.
lines.63: We had made plans so easily.
lines.64: I never thought the day would come when Yashi invited me out so openly.
lines.65: What on earth had happened to her today?
lines.66: Part of me wanted to talk more, but the fireworks were too loud.
lines.67: We could talk all we wanted the day after tomorrow.
lines.68: So for now, we stayed silent.
lines.69: Together, we simply gazed up at the summer night sky.
